newsitem.title: ITALY: Pirelli & C sees positive results for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli & C sees positive results for 1997.

text.p: Italian holding company Pirelli & C, which indirectly controls tyre and cables group Pirelli, on Tuesday said it expected positive results for 1997.

Pirelli & C's vice president Marco Tronchetti Provera told shareholders at the company's annual meeting to approve the company's 1996 accounts and a dividend payment from June 9, that the group forecasts "positive results" for 1997.

Pirelli & C through its holding in Societe Internationale Pirelli SA holds a controlling stake of just over 50 percent in Pirelli. Tronchetti Provera is also chairman and chief executive officer of Pirelli.
